main_text.p: uerit propter nos, vt nimirum subseruiant Ecclesiæ salu-ti. Breuiùs ita: Credo in Deum creatorem, hoc est, credo quòd Deus, qui omnia creauit & prouidentia sua gubernat, me & fideles in mundo creauerit, vt celebremus ipsum, atque vt simus Domini creaturarum. Omnia vestra sunt: vos autem Christi: Christus vero Dei: quasi diceret, Omnia sunt creata propter nos, sicut nos propter Deum.
Ad hanc primam Symboli partem tres Loci communes pertinent, inprimis cognitu necessarij.
main_text.head: DE DEO
main_text.l: 2. Quid sit, seu qualis sit Deus quem colimus, & quid differat ab Idolis.
5. An hæc nomina sint in Ecclesia vsur-panda, & an habeantur in Scriptura.
8. Quare hæc doctrina sit in Ecclesia retinenda.
main_text.p: COgitari satis non potest ingens miseria naturæ hominum, quòd cùm ad illustrem agnitionem atq; adeo imaginem Dei sit condita, eò sit prolapsa, vt non tantùm quis & qualis sit deus, ignoret, verùm etiam, an sit vllus in cœlo deus, disputet. Causas hu-ius mali sola Eccl. intelligit, quarum prima est naturæ humanæ post lapsum cæcitas & depravatio: altera Diaboli impulsus, qui omnem de Deo opinionem

page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment, the start of a sentence from the previous page; the italic "uerit" is partly cut off at the edge, so its first letters are uncertain. The woodcut ornament at left carries a small Q-shaped figure but no text. Small stray marks in the margins are not printed text. "præcipuę." is set on its own line beside the ornament, at the start of the question list, with the heading word "Quæstiones" above it at the edge of the woodcut; it is transcribed as printed.
